query:
WITH ChildCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        d.head_of_household_id,
        COUNT(d.id) - 1 AS child_count  -- Excluding the head
    FROM estishraf_llm_demographics_impala d
    WHERE d.person_status = 'صالح' 
      AND d.death_date IS NULL
      AND d.birth_date IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY d.head_of_household_id
),
WealthWithChildren AS (
    SELECT 
        w.wealth_level,
        COALESCE(c.child_count, 0) AS child_count
    FROM estishraf_llm_wealth_index w
    LEFT JOIN ChildCounts c ON w.head_of_household_id = c.head_of_household_id
)
SELECT 
    wealth_level,
    AVG(child_count) AS avg_children
FROM WealthWithChildren
GROUP BY wealth_level
ORDER BY 
    CASE wealth_level
        WHEN 'Poor' THEN 1
        WHEN 'Lower Middle' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Middle' THEN 3
        WHEN 'Upper Middle' THEN 4
        WHEN 'Rich' THEN 5
    END LIMIT 20000
